problem_restatement.observed: V58 did not open a BTC long during the current trend-up move because its only long route requires an hourly downside sweep below the previous twenty-hour low before reclaim, volume, and EMA55 checks can qualify.
problem_restatement.tested_correction: Remove only the downside-sweep predicate while preserving reclaim, 1.20x volume, EMA55, onset, next-minute taker entry, fixed 60-bps stop, fixed 60-bps maker target, and twenty-four-hour fallback.
problem_restatement.result: The correction increased opportunity but lost materially in every chronological partition and friction scenario.

decision.reason: The candidate failed net PnL, profit factor, largest-winner removal, drawdown, stress, and candidate-versus-control requirements in both validation and pseudo-holdout.

interpretation.high_confidence: Under the frozen one-minute bar contract, the sweep predicate is not an arbitrary blocker: it selects a much smaller and materially stronger historical subset. Removing it is falsified as a BTC long-coverage correction.
interpretation.medium_confidence: The unchanged sweep-qualified control has positive, largest-winner-robust results across the opened chronological partitions, but only about 0.38 to 0.47 completed trades per week and therefore cannot provide frequent BTC long participation.
interpretation.not_established: The historical control does not establish future profitability, and one-minute bars do not prove exact mark-trigger ordering, executable depth, queue, or sub-minute latency.
